Welcome home to 49 Buena Vista Terrace. One of the finest tree lined country roads in all of Central Valley. Located just a stones through from Woodbury recreational park, lake and pool. Situated privately on mature well landscaped 1 plus acre parcel yet convenient to all transportation, shopping and Monroe Woodbury schools. Country cape with a warm farm house feel. Enjoys an open and spacious floor plan yet exudes cozy and comfort in every nook and cranny. Beautiful detailed custom molding and hardwood floors welcome you. Brick gas fireplace can be enjoyed from the main family room, dining room and kitchen. Open bright and airy kitchen with maple cabinetry and granite counter tops. Features a main level bedroom and the convenience of a full bath on all three levels. Lower level has an additional benefit of another 800 finished living space to use as you see fit. Truly a remarkable and pristine home you will be proud to call your own.
